title: Mermaid Roshan: Here I Am!
subtitle: Lantern Night beneath Rumi's pool
authored_by: Claude, 2026-10-17; agent-authored candidate within the owner-approved under-pool premise

plot_threads.A: Roshan's voice: the first line she wants and the courage to use her voice
plot_threads.B: The mystery: why the town's answers vanish (the Boom Shell)
plot_threads.C: Duri: the lanterns he delivers and his own turn
plot_threads.D: The imps: left out, loud, then invited
plot_threads.E: The trio's promise: talking over Roshan, then making room

lyrics: Here I am! / Here you are!
Near or far, / big or small,
We make room for us all!

panels.stage: Night in Pearl Hollow. Roshan in her base look (tiara, detective hat pushed back) at the centre holding a small glowing clam-shell lantern; Rumi, Hana and Nari behind her; Duri with bell and satchel; Grandma Gobuk waving from the bathhouse balcony far back; the Boom Shell's spiral silhouette on the bridge; lanterns rising to the round skylight. No candle anywhere.

Castle Mermaid Pool room at sunset: peach-gold light through the arched windows, the seahorse fountain, the turning rainbow over the waterfall. Roshan (base look, tiara) at the pool edge practises a tiny note at her own reflection; Rumi surfaces behind her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: The castle candle was still missing. But tonight was Lantern Night.

panels.stage: Rumi holds up a small clam shell; inside sleeps a dark glow-jelly. Roshan leans in, hopeful.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Under my pool, everyone sings one line. Then the lanterns light up.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Can I sing the very first line?

panels.stage: Close on two hands: Rumi's and Roshan's little fingers hooked, thumbs pressed together (pinky promise with a thumb stamp).
Roshan alone with her reflection, whispering. Her balloon has a dotted whisper outline.
Montage grid, panel 1: a thread of rainbow light glints under the stone bench beside the pool. Roshan's eyes go wide.
The castle wardrobe doors fly open; a puff of dust; the detective hat on its hook.
The hat lands on Roshan's head far too low; only her mouth shows.
Hat pushed back, tiara peeking under the brim, magnifier raised in a sparkle pose.
Through the magnifier: the rainbow light streams UP through a crack between the floor tiles, not down from the waterfall.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: The light is coming from under the pool!

panels.stage: Roshan presses the glowing shell tile. It twists open like a spiral shell; bubbles rush up; Rumi gasps with delight.

Double-page spread, left half. Roshan and Rumi swim down a rainbow-lit shaft into a hidden town in a deep bowl: the round crystal skylight above (the bottom of Rumi's pool); coral terraces; Shell Market with curved shell roofs and dark lanterns strung between them; the pearl-railed bridge with a glass bubble tram gliding on a ribbon of current. Residents prepare: Crab Baker with fish-shaped pastries, Octopus Tailor sewing eight ribbons, Pufferfish Lantern-maker puffed up, clownfish twins racing. Hidden: the two imps hauling a giant glittery spiral shell up the bridge ramp.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Beneath Rumi's pool was a whole hidden town.

panels.stage: Spread, right half: Kelp Park, the Bubble Bathhouse on its warm vent ridge with bubble plumes, Moon Plaza and the giant scallop Shell Stage at the bottom. Hidden: Duri racing along the bridge with a bulging satchel; Grandma Gobuk on the bathhouse balcony. Roshan, mouth open, in the foreground.
Small inset, bottom right: a huge BOOM from the bridge. Lantern strings sway, fish scatter, Roshan's hair puffs out.
The practice room beside Moon Plaza: a mirror wall and a mother-of-pearl floor. Hana mid-spin with ribbon fans; Nari drumming; mirror reflections double them.
Hana bows hugely; Nari cups a hand to her ear.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: I'm Hana. I do BIG moves!

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: I'm Nari. I hear tiny things.

panels.stage: The trio huddle and plan; their excited balloons overlap and half cover Roshan's small dotted balloon at the edge.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: But I was going to sing the first...

panels.stage: Roshan, small in a corner of the mirror, hat brim drooping.
Moon Plaza: residents in a big ring, each holding a dark clam-shell lantern; the trio on the stage steps. Rumi calls to the circle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: At dusk the town made its circle for the practice call.

panels.stage: The ring opens their mouths to answer. A spiral of sound from off-panel drags their answer balloons sideways out of the frame.
Silence. Every lantern still dark. One bubble rises.
Puzzled residents.
Roshan alone at the plaza rail, ear tilted toward the bridge; tiny letters drift up from the dark arches.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Listen! Someone's tapping under the bridge!

panels.stage: Under the Pearl Bridge a whirlpool spins in the dark gully. Duri is caught in it, his satchel strap snagged on a coil of glittery ribbon cable wound round a bridge post. Clam-shell lanterns fly out of his satchel and spin away.
The friends at the rail; Nari's hand cupped to her ear.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: You were right, Roshan! I hear him too!

panels.stage: Hana dives straight in and grabs Duri's flipper.
Close-up: the strap pulls tight around Duri's shell; strain lines.
Roshan's first big voice: a large solid balloon. Bubbles freeze in the water around her.
Everyone freezes. Hana lets go; the strap loosens a little.
Duri points a flipper at the knot on the glitter cable.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Loosen the knot first. Then I can wiggle out.

panels.stage: Roshan peers at the whirlpool through her magnifier: fish and shells whirl round the edge, but in the very centre one pebble rests perfectly still.
Roshan swims straight into the whirlpool's calm eye; spiral speed lines all round; her rainbow ponytail streams.
In the calm eye, Roshan reaches the knot on the glitter cable.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Hold still, Duri. I've got the knot.

panels.stage: Outside the spin the friends make a chain: Rumi holds Hana's hand, Hana holds Nari's. Nari chants a slow rhythm.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: Wiggle... and wait. Wiggle... and wait.

panels.stage: Close on Roshan's fingers sliding the strap free of the knot.
Overhead the bubble tram rushes across the bridge; its current slams down and the whirlpool spins faster.
Diagonal panel: Roshan and Duri are flung out of the calm eye toward the black gap under the bridge pilings.
Rumi stretches her hand into the spin, the friend-chain straining behind her; fingertips almost touching Roshan's.
Caught: Rumi's hand grips Roshan's and the chain swings Roshan and Duri out of the whirlpool in a big arc.
Everyone tumbles into the soft seagrass of Kelp Park. Duri lands upside down on his shell, spinning like a top.
Nari flips Duri right side up with her tail; everyone laughing. Pip, a tiny dark glow-jelly, peeks out of the seagrass behind Roshan.
Duri looks into his empty satchel; lanterns lie scattered across the meadow and the bridge.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: My lanterns! Every home needs one tonight!

panels.stage: Hana pulls a lantern out of the kelp.
Nari hears one rattling under a rock.
Roshan spots one behind a sea star with her magnifier.
Roshan studies the torn strap through the magnifier: glitter flakes and a spiral-shaped scrape.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Glitter. And a big spiral mark.

panels.stage: Nari and Roshan put it together.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: The whirlpool started right after the BOOM.

panels.stage: Duri, sandy and draped in seaweed, holds up the one pearly lantern with no name on it.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: I'm all sandy. And this lantern has no name.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Grandma Gobuk will know. To the bathhouse!

panels.stage: The Bubble Bathhouse interior: warm basins stepping up the rock in rose, mint and gold; bubble plumes; a cleaning station among sponge corals; the round Echo Dome; the long lounge beyond. Guests in matching striped robes and sheep-towel hats. Grandma Gobuk, a very old turtle in round spectacles with an orange float under one flipper, greets them.

entries.speaker: Grandma Gobuk
entries.text: Robes on, towels up, worries off!

panels.stage: A hermit-crab attendant hands out matching striped robes.
Nari rolls a towel into sheep ears on her own head.
Eggs baking brown on warm vent stones.
Duri holds up the nameless pearly lantern; Grandma Gobuk peers at it over her spectacles.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Grandma, who is this one for?

entries.speaker: Grandma Gobuk
entries.text: There's always one more lantern, for someone we forgot.

panels.stage: Nari offers Roshan a sheep towel; Roshan holds up her hands, then grins and plops the sheep ears onto her detective hat instead.
Duri lies on a warm flat rock while cleaner shrimp and yellow tang fish nibble the algae from his shell.
Roshan scrubs gently with a soft sponge; bubbles.

Under the algae Duri's mint flower shell shines, and stuck to it is a smear of glitter paint stamped with the imps' tiny top-hat logo, the same logo painted all over the Boom Shell and its cable. Roshan's magnifier hovers over it.
Hana frowns, arms folded.

entries.speaker: Hana
entries.text: But why would imps make BOOMs?

panels.stage: The round Echo Dome, softly lit; Grandma Gobuk in the doorway.

entries.speaker: Grandma Gobuk
entries.text: In here, even a whisper sings.

panels.stage: Roshan, nervous, sings one tiny note in a dotted balloon.
The note rings round the dome in widening circles; the friends gasp; Roshan beams.
BOOM from outside: the echo rings are sucked out through the doorway in a spiral; the dome falls silent.
Roshan, finger raised, detective face.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: When the BOOM comes, every little voice disappears!

panels.stage: The friends soak in the rose basin, robes on. Rumi looks down.

entries.speaker: Rumi
entries.text: Roshan, I promised you the first line. Then I talked right over you.

panels.stage: Hana and Nari own their parts.

entries.speaker: Nari
entries.text: And my drum was a BOOM too.

panels.stage: Roshan holds out her little finger; Rumi hooks it and presses her thumb.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: I still want the first line. Will you listen?

panels.stage: Grandma Gobuk leans over the basin edge and whistles a long clear note, drawn as a thin streaming line.

entries.speaker: Grandma Gobuk
entries.text: When I come up from a deep dive, I whistle so my friends know I'm still here. Hoo-wee!

panels.stage: Roshan purses her lips and tries; far across the room, Duri's head pops up.

The lounge: a long heated stone floor and a low table the length of the room: kelp rolls, fish-shaped pastries, honey rice-cake skewers, a fruit mountain crowned with star fruit, flower cookies, brown baked eggs, sweet rice drink in lidded shells with straws. Everyone lies on the warm floor or the long shell couch in robes and sheep towels; Grandma Gobuk at the head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Then came the Lantern Night feast.

panels.stage: Nari taps a baked egg on her own sheep towel.
Duri tries to eat the fruit mountain from the bottom; a grape avalanche.
Roshan stands on a cushion. The trio sit on their hands, smiling, making space.
Roshan closes her eyes and begins, in a small but solid balloon.
The trio lean in, eyes shining.

The doors burst open: the Glitter Imp and the Top-Hat Imp roll the giant spiral Boom Shell through the lounge on its cart. Roshan's half-sung line is sucked into the spiral; lamps blow out; sheep towels fly; the bathhouse bubbles stop.
Outside, every lantern in Pearl Hollow is dark. The Boom Shell rolls along the Pearl Bridge toward the stage, the imps riding on top.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Every lantern in Pearl Hollow went dark.

panels.stage: Roshan, in her robe and sheep-eared detective hat, holds up the evidence: glitter on her finger, the top-hat print, the spiral scrape.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Your Boom Shell makes the whirlpools. It swallows everyone's voices!

panels.stage: The imps, defensive, arms folded on top of the shell.

entries.speaker: Top-Hat Imp
entries.text: Nobody invited us to Lantern Night!

entries.speaker: Glitter Imp
entries.text: So we'll be SO loud, everyone hears US!

panels.stage: The imps roll the Boom Shell off toward the stage.
The trio, deflated in the dark.
Roshan stands up, sheep ears flopping on her hat.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Then we'll make an answer so clear, nothing can swallow it.

panels.stage: The Octopus Tailor tosses ribbons to Hana.
Nari hands glow-jelly lightsticks to the crowd.
Roshan steps into her Pop Star outfit; Rumi clips a star into her hair.
Duri polishes his bell; the nameless lantern swings from his satchel.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Maybe tonight I'll get a turn too.

panels.stage: All five at the stage door, backlit by harsh magenta stage light.
Spread left. The Shell Stage at night: the imps' show of bubble cannons, foam stars and spotlights, the Boom Shell blasting. Every cheer from the dark crowd curls into its spiral mouth.
The Tidebells slide in from the wings, dodging foam stars; Hana catches one in a ribbon cloth.
Duri rings his bell to mark a safe path through the bubbles.
Spread right. Roshan swims a path through a maze of giant bubbles toward the Boom Shell: under, around, through.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Under the bubbles. Around the foam. Through!

panels.stage: The Boom Shell pulls harder: lightsticks, a top hat, a cupcake and foam stars spiral in.
The Top-Hat Imp, too close, is sucked into the spiral. Only his hand sticks out, waving.
The Top-Hat Imp's small balloon curls back into the spiral before it can reach anyone.
The Glitter Imp is still bowing to the crowd, eyes shut, unaware.
Only Roshan sees the tiny waving hand.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: He's calling! Nobody can hear him!

panels.stage: Roshan looks at the empty centre spot with its microphone, then back at the waving hand.
Roshan swims away from the microphone, toward the shell.
The trio form their chain behind her, the same chain as under the bridge.
Roshan dives into the Boom Shell's spiral mouth.
Inside the spiral: pearly pink and quiet, the calm eye again. Every swallowed sound floats here as soft bubbles of words; the Top-Hat Imp is curled up in the middle.
Roshan reaches him and takes his hand.
Roshan pulls; the spiral pulls back harder.
A small inset of Grandma Gobuk whistling. Roshan purses her lips and whistles softly; a thin bright line of sound streams up the spiral and out.
Outside, Nari's ear twitches.
Nari spreads her arms to the whole plaza.
Hana stops spinning; the crowd lowers its lightsticks; the Glitter Imp stops mid-bow. Silence.
With no noise to swallow, the Boom Shell slows, trembles and hiccups.

The Boom Shell coughs out every swallowed sound: hundreds of word-bubbles burst over the plaza and pop into sparkles. Roshan and the Top-Hat Imp tumble out into the trio's chain; the Glitter Imp catches his friend.
The imps, ashamed, hats in hands.

entries.speaker: Glitter Imp
entries.text: We were so loud... because nobody asked us to come.

panels.stage: Duri swims up with the nameless pearly lantern.

entries.speaker: Duri
entries.text: Grandma says there's always one more lantern, for someone we forgot.

panels.stage: The imps turn the Boom Shell round so its mouth points up at the skylight.

entries.speaker: Top-Hat Imp
entries.text: No more booming. Let it carry voices UP!

panels.stage: The trio step aside; Rumi guides Roshan to the centre of the ring.
Close-up: Roshan, small and a little wobbly, sings in a full solid balloon.
The whole town answers in a giant ring. Pip, the stray glow-jelly at Roshan's side, lights first; a ripple of light starts round the circle.
Double-page spread, left half: the ring of Pearl Hollow sings; every lantern lights and rises up through the turned Lantern Horn toward the skylight. Small balloons round the circle.

entries.speaker: Everyone
entries.text: Near or far, big or small, we make room for us all!

panels.stage: Spread, right half: Roshan in the centre of the ring, face lit by her lantern, hat in hand: the ending close-up. Lanterns stream up into the skylight.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: And every voice lit a lantern.

panels.stage: Small inset: Rumi points up at the first lanterns slipping through the skylight.
The castle Mermaid Pool room at night: Rumi's pool glows gold from below with hundreds of little lanterns bobbing in it; the turning rainbow shines brighter; Roshan and Rumi rise to the surface.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.text: Back home, Rumi's pool glowed all night.

panels.stage: On the pool edge Roshan turns her detective hat in her hands.

entries.speaker: Roshan
entries.text: Tomorrow, can we look for our candle?

panels.stage: From deep below, a faint whistle; Roshan whistles back, smiling.
